Wenzhi Zhao

About

Exploring how faults slip, heal, and generate earthquakes.

Asian School of the Environment (ASE)
Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS)
Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

I am a PhD candidate in Earth and Environmental Science at Nanyang Technological University, advised by Luca Dal Zilio. I study earthquake physics and rock mechanics through laboratory shear experiments and earthquake cycle simulations, with a particular focus on fault friction and healing.

Research interests

  • Earthquake physics
  • Rock mechanics
  • Fault friction
  • Laboratory shear experiments
  • Earthquake cycle simulations
